confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident; accommodation and cocktail/wine anchors are less certain because July is peak season and Turkish prices move with lira inflation. The FX value (0.6955 USD per AUD, 2026-10-15) came from a search summary citing rba.gov.au/exchange-rates-overview.html. I could not open the RBA F11 table to confirm it, so verify it against the table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is the Turkish Aegean and Mediterranean resort-coast price level (Marmaris, Kalkan, Bodrum), set somewhat below Greek and Croatian Mediterranean resort towns. Cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to beer, using the usual ratio of a restaurant cocktail or wine glass to a draught beer. No web search was used for the city-price anchors.
